content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Presets stripe

The infrastructure problem lies in the dependence on platforms like Stripe, Gumroad, and Paddle, which operate in only 46 countries out of 195 on earth. This creates a global divide, where creators from restricted countries are forced to either abandon online sales or rely on insecure, platform-dependent workarounds. The Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure is a base-layer solution that empowers creators to collect payments and deliver digital products independently, without relying on Stripe or any other restricted platform.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure is built on a stack of free and paid tools, including Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments is used for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a fee of 0.5% and support for over 300 cryptocurrencies. This architecture is designed to be self-sufficient and infrastructure-owned, rather than platform-reliant.
Who This Is Built For and Why

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure empowers creators to collect payments independently without relying on restricted platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure consists of several key components, including the Edge Commerce Stack, which is a pre-configured stack that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack is deployed in 48 hours and includes 30-day support. Additionally, the Sovereign Blueprint provides complete documentation and source code for all five stacks, while the Complete Builder Kit offers instant access to all six blueprints and seven templates.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a pre-configured solution for creators.

For digital creators looking for alternative solutions to Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle, the Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure offers a comprehensive and secure solution. Additionally, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a pre-configured solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Visit the shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
